fewShots.question: How many new business policies were issued per product?
fewShots.query:
select
    FactNewBusiness.ProductCode,
    count(FactNewBusiness.Policy_BK) as PolicyCount
from [sales].[FactNewBusiness] as FactNewBusiness
group by FactNewBusiness.ProductCode

fewShots.question: What is the total annualised premium by month of issue?
fewShots.query:
select
    datefromparts(year(FactNewBusiness.IssueDate),
        month(FactNewBusiness.IssueDate), 1) as IssueMonth,
    sum(FactNewBusiness.AnnualPremiumAmount) as AnnualPremiumTotal
from [sales].[FactNewBusiness] as FactNewBusiness
group by datefromparts(year(FactNewBusiness.IssueDate),
    month(FactNewBusiness.IssueDate), 1)

fewShots.question: What is the average annual premium per policy for each product?
fewShots.query:
select
    FactNewBusiness.ProductCode,
    avg(FactNewBusiness.AnnualPremiumAmount) as AveragePremium
from [sales].[FactNewBusiness] as FactNewBusiness
group by FactNewBusiness.ProductCode
